English: Over 600 foreign species of plants and animals have invaded South Africa, but only 34 South African species have invaded other countries.
Luganda: Ebika by’ebimera n’ebisolo ebisukka mu 600 eby’ebweru byazinda South Afirika, naye ebika by’e South Afirika 34 byokka bye byagenda mu mawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀yà ọ̀gbìn àti ẹranko àjòjì tó ju 600 lọ ni ó yabo South Áfíríkà, ṣùgbọ́n ẹ̀yà South Áfíríkà 34 péré ni ó ti yabo àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn.
Zulu: Zingaphezu kuka-600 izinhlobo zezitshalo nezilwane zangaphandle ezihlasele iNingizimu Afrika, kodwa zingama-34 kuphela izinhlobo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezihlasele amanye amazwe.
Hausa: Fiye da jinsunan tsirrai da dabbobi na waje guda 600 sun mamaye Afirka ta Kudu, amma jinsunan Afirka ta Kudu guda 34 ne kawai suka mamaye wasu ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Mehuta ya dimela le diphoofolo tša ka dinageng tša ka ntle tša go feta tše 600 di šwahletše ka Afrika Borwa, eupša ke fela mehuta ye 34 ya Afrika Borwa yeo e šwahletšego ka dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: ከ600 በላይ የአትክልት እና የእንስሳት ዝርያዎች ደቡብ አፍሪካን ወረዋል፤ ነገር ግን 34 የደቡብ አፍሪካ ዝርያዎች ብቻ ሌሎች ሃገሮችን ወረዋል።

English: This is according to researchers who, for the first time, documented native South African species exported to other countries.
Luganda: Bino byazuulibwa abanoonyereza ng’omulundi ogwasookera ddala baawandiika ku bika binnansangwa eby’e South Afirika ebyatwalibwa mu mawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Èyí jẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohun tí aṣèwádìí tí ó kọ́kọ́ ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ ẹ̀yà abínibí South Áfíríkà tó wọ́n kó wọ àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn.
Zulu: Lokhu kuvele kubacwaningi, ngokokuqala ngqa, babhala ngezinhlobo zezilwane zaseNingizimu Afrika ezithunyelwa kwamanye amazwe.
Hausa: Wannan shi ne, a cewar masu binciken, waɗanda a karon farko, sun rubuta jinsuna 'yan asalin Afirka ta Kudu da ake fitar da su zuwa wasu ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Se ke go ya ka banyakišiši bao, la mathomo, ba ilego ba ngwalwa pego ka ga mehuta ya diphedi tša setlogo tša ka Afrika Borwa tveo di šwahletšego ka dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: ይህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ሌሎች ሃገራት የተወሰዱ የደቡብ አፍሪካ ተወላጅ ዝርያዎችን የመዘገቡ ተመራማሪዎች የሚሉት ነው።

English: Invasive species include plants and animals not native to an area, which may overpopulate and harm that area.
Luganda: Ebika ebitwalibwa mu mawanga amalala mulimu ebimera n’ebisolo ebitali binnansangwa mu kitundu, ebiyinza okuzaalukana ne bireeta obulabe mu kitundu ekyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn àjòjì ọgánísíìmù yìí jẹ́ ọgbìn àti ẹranko tó jẹ́ àjòjì sí àgbègbè kan, èyí tí ó lè pọ̀ jù tí ó sì lè ṣe ìjàmbá fún agbègbè náà.
Zulu: Izinhlobo ezihlaselayo zihlanganisa izitshalo nezilwane ezingazalelwanga endaweni, ezingase zigcwale futhi zilimaze leyo ndawo.
Hausa: Nau’o’i masu mamayewa sun haɗa da tsirrai da dabbobin da ba na asali ba zuwa wani yanki, wanda kuma yana iya yin yawa da kuma cutar da yankin.
Northern Sotho: Mehuta ya diphedi tše di šwahlelago di akaretša dimela le diphoofolo tšeo e sego tša setlogo sa lefelo leo, tšeo di ka tlalago go fetišiša le go senya lefelo leo.
Amharic: ወራሪ ዝርያዎች በአንድ አካባቢ ተወላጅ የሆኑ አትክልቶችን እና እንስሳትን የሚያካትቱ ሲሆን እነዚህም አካባቢውን ከመጠን በላይ ሊሞሉ እና ጉዳት ሊያደርሱ ይችላሉ።

English: Throughout history, humans have brought species native to one country into other countries where they were not naturally found.
Luganda: Mu byafaayo, abantu bazzenga batwala ebika okuva mu ggwanga erimu okudda mu malala gye bitaali mu kusooka.
Yoruba: Nínú gbogbo ìtàn, àwọn ẹ̀ẹ̀yàn tí gbé ẹ̀yà tí ó jẹ́ abínibí sí orílẹ̀-èdè kan wọ inú orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn tí a kò lè déédéé rí wọn.
Zulu: Kuwo wonke umlando, abantu baye baletha izinhlobo zezilwane ezizalelwa kwelinye izwe kwamanye amazwe lapho bezingatholakali khona ngokwemvelo.
Hausa: A cikin tarihi, ’yan’adam sun kawo jinsunan ’yan asali zuwa wata ƙasa ɗaya zuwa wasu ƙasashen da ba a same su ta zahiri ba.
Northern Sotho: Ka nakong ya historing ka moka, batho ba ile ba tliša mehuta ya diphedi ka nageng e tee go ya ka dinageng tše dingwe fao di bego di sa hwetšwego gona ka tlhago.
Amharic: በታሪክ ውስጥ ሰዎች የአንድ ሃገር ተወላጅ የሆኑ ዝርያዎችን በተፈጥሮ ወደማይገኙባቸው ወደሌሎች ሃገሮች አምጥተዋል።

English: Until now, little was known about how many South African species had been taken to other parts of the world, and how this number compares to the number of foreign species brought into South Africa from other countries.
Luganda: Ne we butuukidde kati, kitono ekibadde kimanyiddwa ku bika bimeka eby’e South Afirika ebyatwalibwa mu bitundu by’ensi ebirala, n’engeri omuwendo guno gye guyinza okugeraageranyizibwa ku muwendo gw’ebika ebigwira ebyaleetebwa mu South Afirika okuva mu mawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Títí di òní olónìí, díẹ̀ ni a mọ̀ nípa iye ẹ̀yà South Áfíríkà tí wọ́n ti kó wọ àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn, àti ìfiwéra iye ẹ̀yà àjòjì tí wọ́n kó wọ South Áfíríkà láti orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn.
Zulu: Kuze kube manje, kuncane okwaziwayo ngokuthi zingaki izinhlobo zezilwane zaseNingizimu Afrika eziyiswe kwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba, nokuthi lesi sibalo siqhathaniswa kanjani nenani lezilwane zangaphandle ezilethwa eNingizimu Afrika zivela kwamanye amazwe.
Hausa: Kawo yanzu, ba a san adadin jinsunan Afirka ta Kudu da aka kai zuwa wasu sassan duniya ba, da kuma yadda wannan adadin ya kwatanta da yawan nau'in na ƙasashen waje da ake shigo da su Afirka ta Kudu daga wasu ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Go fihla mo lebakeng le, go be go tsebja gannyane mabapi le ka fao mehuta ye mentši ya diphedi tša ka Afrika Borwa di ilego tša išwa ka dikarolong tše dingwe tša lefase, le ka fao palo ye e ka bapetšwago ka gona le palo ya mehuta ya diphedi tša dinaga tše dingwe tšeo di tlišitšwego ka Afrika Borwa go tšwa ka dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: እስካሁን ምን ያህል የደቡብ አፍሪካ ዝርያዎች ወደሌሎች የአለም ክፍሎች እንደተወሰዱ እና ይህ ቁጥር ከሌሎች ሃገራት ወደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ ከመጡ ባእድ ዝርያዎች ጋር እንዴት እንደሚወዳደር የሚታወቀው ትንሽ ብቻ ነው።

English: Researchers used public information to make a list of all the species from South Africa that were found in other parts of the world, and they interviewed experts in this field.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakozesa obubaka obw’olukale okukola olukalala lw’ebika byonna eby’omu South Afirika ebyasangibwa mu bitundu by’ensi ebirala, era ne babuuza n’abakugu mu kisaawe kino.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí lo àlàyé gbogbogbò láti se àtòjọ gbogbo àwọn ẹ̀yà South Áfíríkà tí wọ́n rí ní àwọn orílè-èdè mìíràn, wọ́n sì fọ̀rọ̀ wá àwọn akọ́ṣémọṣẹ́ nínú iṣẹ́ náà lẹ́nu wò.
Zulu: Abacwaningi basebenzisa ulwazi lomphakathi ukwenza uhlu zonke izinhlobo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezatholakala kwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba, futhi baxoxisana nochwepheshe kulo mkhakha.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun yi amfani da bayanan jama'a don samar da jerin sunayen dukkan jinsunan daga Afirka ta Kudu da aka samu a wasu sassan duniya, kuma sun yi hira da masana a wannan fanni.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šomišitše tshedimošo ye e tšwago setšhabeng go dira lenaneo la mehuta ya diphedi ka moka tša ka Afrika Borwa tšeo di hweditšwego ka dikarolong tše dingwe tša lefase, gomme ba ile ba botsološa ditsebi tša ka mo lefapheng le.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ከደቡብ አፍሪካ የመጡትን እና በሌሎች የአለም ክፍሎች የሚገኙትን ዝርያዎች ዝርዝር ለመስራት የህዝብ መረጃን ተጠቅመዋል በዚህ መስክ ዙሪያም ለኤክስፐርቶች ቃለመጠይቅ አድርገዋል።

English: They found that South Africa had been invaded by 629 alien species from other countries, but only 34 South African species are found elsewhere in the world.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti South Africa yali eyingiddemu ebika ebigwira 629 okuva mu mawanga amalala, so ng’ebika 34 byokka eby’e South Afrika bye bisangibwa mu bitundu by’ensi ebirala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàwárí pé ẹ̀yà àjòjì 629 láti orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn ló yàbo South Áfíríkà, ṣùgbọ́n ẹ̀yà South Áfíríkà 34 péré ni wọ́n rí ní ibòmíìràn ní àgbáyé.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ihlaselwe yizinhlobo ezingama-629 zakwamanye amazwe, kodwa zingu-34 kuphela izinhlobo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezitholakala kwezinye izindawo emhlabeni.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa wasu baƙin jinsuna guda 629 daga wasu ƙasashe sun mamaye Afirka ta Kudu, amma nau’o’in jinsunan Afirka ta Kudu guda 34 ne kawai ake samu a wasu wurare a duniya.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba utolla gore Afrika Borwa e šwahletšwe ke mehuta ya diphedi tše e sego tša setlogo tše 629 go tšwa ka dinageng tše dingwe, eupša ke fela mehuta ya diphedi tše 34 tša ka Afrika Borwa tšeo di hwetšwago go gongwe lefaseng.
Amharic: ደቡብ አፍሪካ በሌሎች 629 ባእድ ዝርያዎች እንደተወረረ አግኝተዋል። ነገር ግን 34 ብቻ የደቡብ አፍሪካ ዝርያዎች በአለም ውስጥ በሌላ ቦታ ተገኝተዋል።

English: Most of these are animals - several monkeys and birds, for instance, are found in zoos in other countries.
Luganda: Ebisolo ebisinga ku bino – okugeza enkima n’ebinyonyi bingi, bisangibwa mu makuumiro g’ebisolo mu mawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ẹranko ni èyí jẹ́- ọ̀pọ̀ ọ̀bọ àti ẹyẹ, fún àpẹrẹ, wà ní àwọn ọgbà ẹran ní orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn.
Zulu: Eziningi zalezi yizilwane - izinkawu nezinyoni ezimbalwa, isibonelo, zitholakala ezindaweni zokugcinwa izilwane kwamanye amazwe.
Hausa: Yawancin waɗannan dabbobi ne - akwai birai da tsuntsaye da yawa, alal misali, ana samun su a cikin gidajen namun daji a wasu ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja diphoofolo tše – e lego dikgabo tše mmalwa le dinonyana, go fa mohlala, di hwetšwa ka afelong a bolotadiphoofolo ka dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ አብዛኛዎቹ እንስሳት ናቸው -ለምሳሌ ብዙ ጦጣዎች እና ወፎች በሌሎች ሃገራት የሚገኙት በመካነ አራዊት ውስጥ ነው።

English: South Africa is also responsible for a “bridgehead effect”, which is when foreign animals or plants that are introduced become established in their new country, but then become a source of invasion in other countries.
Luganda: South Afrika era evunaanyizibwa ku nkola eyitibwa “bridgehead effect”, nga muno ebisolo n’ebirime ebigwira ebiyingizibwa mu ggwanga bitebenkera mu ggwanga lyabyo eppya, naye ate ne bifuuka ensibuko y’okutwalibwa mu mawanga amalala.
Yoruba: South Áfíríkà náà ní ọwọ́ nínú “ipa dídá ọ̀nà” èyí ni ti ẹranko àjòjì tàbí ọ̀gbìn tí wọ́n kó wọ ìlú kan gbinlẹ̀ ní ìlú náà, ṣùgbọ́n tí wọ́n dì orísun ìgbógun tì ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn.
Zulu: INingizimu Afrika nayo inesibopho “somphumela we-bridgehead”, okulapho izilwane zangaphandle noma izitshalo ezethulwayo ziqala ukusungulwa ezweni lazo elisha, kodwa bese kuba umthombo wokuhlasela kwamanye amazwe.
Hausa: Afirka ta Kudu kuma ita ce take da alhakin "sake mamayewa", wanda shi ne lokacin da dabbobi ko tsirrai na waje waɗanda aka bullo da su suka kafu a sabuwar ƙasarsu. amma sai ya zama tushen mamayewa a wasu ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Afrika Borwa ke yona gape e rwele maikarabelo a “Go tlala ga diphedi tša go šwahlela go fetela dinageng tše dingwe”, e lego ge diphoofolo tša dinaga tše dingwe goba dimela tšeo di tlišwago ka nageng ye nngwe di thoma go tlala kudu ka nageng ya tšona ye mpsha, eupša go tloga fao tša fetoga seo se bakago go šwahlela go ya ka dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ደቡብ አፍሪካ “ለድልድይ ራስ ተጽእኖ” ተጠያቂ ስትሆን፣ ይህም ባእድ እንስሳት ወይም አትክልቶች ሲተዋወቁ፣ በአዲሱ ሃገር ሲመሰረቱ እና በሌሎች ሃገሮች ግን የወረራ ምንጭ ሲሆኑ ማለት ነው።

English: As an example, crayfish were introduced into South Africa in the 1970’s, but they were then introduced to other neighbouring Africa countries like Swaziland, Zambia and Mozambique, both intentionally and accidentally.
Luganda: Ekyokulabirako, ebyennyanja ebiyitibwa ‘crayfish’ byaleetebwa mu South Afrika mu gya 1970, naye oluvannyuma ne bitwalibwa mu mawanga ga Afrika agaliraanyeewo nga Swaziland, Zambia ne Mozambique, nga kikolebwa mu bugenderevu na butanwa.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, ọdún 1970 ni wọ́n kó edé wọ South Áfíríkà, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n mọ̀ọ́mọ̀, wọ́n sì kó wọ́n wọ àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Áfíríkà mìíràn bi Swaziland, Zambia, àti Mozambique láìròtẹ́lẹ̀.
Zulu: Njengesibonelo, inkalankala yethulwa eNingizimu Afrika ngeminyaka yawo-1970, kodwa yabe yethulwa kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika angomakhelwane njengeSwaziland, Zambia kanye neMozambique, kokubili ngamabomu nangengozi.
Hausa: Alal misali, an shigar da kifin karafish zuwa Afirka ta Kudu a cikin shekarun 1970, amma sai aka gabatar da su zuwa wasu ƙasashe maƙwabta na Afirka kamar Swaziland da Zambiya da kuma Mozambique da gangan da kuma ba da gangan ba.
Northern Sotho: Bjalo ka mohlala, di-crayfish di ile tša tlišwa ka Afrika Borwa ka mengwageng ya bo 1970, eupša go tloga fao di ile tša šwahlela ka dinageng tše dingwe tša kgauswi tša Afrika tša go swana le ka Swaziland, Zambia le Mozambique, bobedi ka maikemišetšo le ka phošo.
Amharic: እንደምሳሌ፣ ክሬፊሽ ወደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ የተዋወቁት በ1970ዎቹ ሲሆን በመቀጠል ወደሌሎቸ እንደ ስዋዚላንድ፣ ዛምቢያ እና ሞዛምቢክ የመሳሰሉ ጎረቤት የአፍሪካ ሃገሮች ሆን ተብሎም በድንገትም ተዋውቀዋል።

English: The same happened with fish species like trout, carp and basses that were introduced into Swaziland, Lesotho, Zimbabwe and other countries.
Luganda: Ekintu kyekimu kyaliwo ku bika by’ebyennyanja nga trout, carp ne basses ebyayingizibwa mu Swaziland, Lesotho, Zimbabwe n’amawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Ohun kannáà ni ó ṣẹlẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ẹ̀yà ẹja bí i trout, carp, àti basses tí wọ́n kó wọ Swaziland, Lesotho,Zimbabwe àti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn.
Zulu: Kwenzeka okufanayo ngezinhlobo zezinhlanzi ezifana ne-trout, carp nama-bass ezethulwa eSwaziland, eLesotho, eZimbabwe nakwamanye amazwe.
Hausa: Haka nan ya faru da jinsunan kifi kamar turawut da kaf da kuma basis waɗanda aka shigar cikin Swaziland da Lesotho da Zimbabwe da kuma sauran ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Se se ile sa direga gape le ka mehuta ya dihlapi tša go swana le trout, carp le basses tšeo di ilego tša šwahlela le ka Swaziland, Lesotho, Zimbabwe le ka dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: እንደ ትራውት፣ ካርፕ እና ቤስስ የመሳሰሉ ወደ ስዋዚላንድ፣ ሌሶቶ ፣ ዚምባብዌ እና ወደ ሌሎች ሃገሮች በተዋወቁ በሌሎች የአሳ ዝርያዎች ላይ ተመሳሳይ ነገር ተከስቷል።

English: Researchers also found that 3 species were traded by people who wanted African animals in their countries.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baakizuula nti ebika 3 byasuubulwa abantu abaali baagala ebisolo by’omu Afrika mu mawanga gaabwe.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàwári pé awọn èèyàn kan tí wọ́n fẹ́ ẹranko Áfíríkà ní orílẹ̀-èdè ta ẹ̀yà 3.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi izinhlobo ezi-3 zazidayiswa ngabantu abafuna izilwane zase-Afrika emazweni abo.
Hausa: Haka nan masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa mutanen da suke son dabbobin Afirka a cikin ƙasashensu suna cinikin nau’o’i guda 3.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gape gore mehuta ye 3 e ile ya rekwa ke batho bao ba bego ba nyaka diphoofolo tša Afrika ka dinageng tša bona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች እንዳገኙት የአፍሪካ እንስሳት በሃገራቸው እንዲኖሩ በሚፈልጉ ሰዎች 3 ዝርያዎችን ተገበያይተው ነበር።

English: The introduction of these species in those countries was considered invasive, because they harmed local species.
Luganda: Okuleeta ebika bino mu mawanga ago kyatwalibwa ng’okulumbibwa, kubanga byakosa ebika binnansangwa.
Yoruba: Kíkó àwọn ẹ̀yà yìí wọ inú orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn ni wọ́n pè ní àfòmọ́, nítorí wọ́n ṣe ìpalára fún àwọn ẹ̀yà àgbègbè ibẹ̀.
Zulu: Ukwethulwa kwalezi zinhlobo kulawo mazwe kwakubhekwa njengento engavamile, ngoba zazilimaza izinhlobo zendawo.
Hausa: Gabatar da waɗannan jinsuna a cikin waɗannan ƙasashe an ɗauke su kamar mamayewa ne, saboda suna cutar da jinsunan gida.
Northern Sotho: Go tlišwa ga mehuta ye ya diphedi ka fao dinageng tšeo go ilwe gwa bonwa bjalo ka go šwahlela, ka gobane di be di kweša bohloko diphedi tša ka nageng yeo.
Amharic: እነዚህን ዝርያዎች በእነዛ ሃገራት ማስተዋወቅ በአካባቢው ዝርያዎች ላይ ጉዳት ስላደረሰ እንደ ወረራ ተቆጥሮ ነበር።

English: The rest of the species were not as invasive and could have been introduced accidentally through transport.
Luganda: Ebika ebirala tebyali bya bulabe era biyinza okuba nga byaleetebwa mu butanwa okuyita mu byentambula.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀yà yòókù kì í fi bẹ́ẹ̀ ṣe àfòmọ́, ó sì ṣe é ṣẹ kí wọ́n kó wọ́n wọlé láìmọ̀ nípasẹ̀ gbígbé wọn kiri.
Zulu: Zonke ezinye izinhlobo azizange zihlasele futhi zazingethulwa ngengozi ngezinto zokuhamba.
Hausa: Sauran jinsunan ba su kasance masu mamayewa ba kuma ana iya gabatar da su ta hanyar sufuri.
Northern Sotho: Diphedi tše dingwe di be di se tšeo di bego di šwahlela gomme tšona di ka be di tlišitšwe ka dinageng tšeo ka phošo ka dinamelwa.
Amharic: ሌሎቹ ዝርያዎች ያን ያህል ወራሪ አልነበሩም እና በጉዞ ጊዜ በድንገት ተዋውቀው ሊሆን ይችላል።

English: For instance, insects usually found on African trees were spotted in southern Europe.
Luganda: Okugeza, ebiwuka ebitera okusangibwa ku miti gy’omu Afrika byalabwako mu bukiikaddyo bwa Bulaaya.
Yoruba: Bí àpẹẹrẹ, wọ́n rí àwọn kòkòrò tí wọ́n máa ń rìn lára àwọn igi Áfíríkà ní apá gúsù Europe.
Zulu: Ngokwesibonelo, izinambuzane ezivame ukutholakala ezihlahleni zase-Afrika zazibonwa eningizimu yeYurophu.
Hausa: Alal misali, ana ganin ƙwari da aka fi samu a kan bishiyoyin Afirka a kudancin Turai.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, dikhunkhwane tšeo ka tlwaelo di hwetšagalago mehlareng ya Afrika di ile tša bonwa ka borwa bja Yuropa.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ በአፍሪካ ዛፎች ላይ የሚገኙ ነፍሳት በደቡብ አውሮፓ ታይተው ነበር።

English: The researchers said these could have been transported there on wood or on people’s clothing or bags.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti bino biyinza okuba nga byatwalibwayo ku mbaawo oba ku ngoye oba ensawo z'abantu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pè ó ṣe é ṣe kí wọ́n gbé wọ́n débẹ̀ nípasẹ̀ igi, tàbí ara aṣọ tàbí àpò.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi lezi bezingathuthwa lapho ngezinkuni noma ngezingubo noma izikhwama zabantu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce ana iya jigilar waɗannan a kan itace ko a kan tufafi ko jakunkuna na mutane.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore tšona di ka be di tlišitšwe fao ka dikgong goba ka diaparo tša batho goba ka mekotlana ya bona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በባሊ ወረዳ ሆስፒታል ያሉትን እና ከ18 አመት በላይ የሆናቸውን የኤችአይቪ ተጠቂ ታካሚዎች አጥንተዋል፡፡

English: They found that frogs, specifically Xenopus laevis, moved around other Africa countries and from South Africa.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti ebikere, naddala Xenopus laevis, byagenda mu mawanga ga Afrika amalala okuva mu South Africa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sàwárí ọ̀pọ̀lọ́ kan pàtó , Xenopus laevis, tí ó rìn kiri àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè láti South Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi amaxoxo, ikakhulukazi i-Xenopus laevis, azulazula kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika naseNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa kwaɗi, musamman Xenopus laevis, sun yi tafiya zuwa wasu ƙasashen Afirka daga Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore digwaga, kudukudu tva mohuta way Xenopus laevis, di ile tša ya dinageng tše dingwe tša Afrika le go tšw aka Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: በሌሎች የአፍሪካ፣ ደቡብ አሜሪካ እና እስያ ክፍሎች ከተሰበሰቡ ናሙናዎች የተገኙ መረጃዎችንም ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

English: They were being used for research in different places and some of them may have escaped and bred with other frog species.
Luganda: Byali bikozesebwa mu kunoonyereza mu bifo eby’enjawulo era ebimu biyinza okuba nga byatoloka ne bizaala nga byegasse n’ebika by’ebikere ebirala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n lò wọ́n fún àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ní àwọn ibi kọ̀ọ̀kan, àwọn kan nínú wọn sì ti lé sálọ, kí wọ́n sì ní ìbálòpọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹ̀yà ọ̀pọ̀lọ́ mìíràn.
Zulu: Bezisetshenziselwa ucwaningo ezindaweni ezahlukene kanti ezinye zazo kungenzeka ziphunyukile zazalaniswa nezinye izinhlobo zamaxoxo.
Hausa: An yi amfani da su domin bincike a wurare daban-daban kuma wasu daga cikinsu sun iya tserewa tare da wasu jinsunan kwaɗi.
Northern Sotho: Tšona di be di šomišwa go dira dinyakišišo ka mafelong ao a fapafapanego gomme tše dingwe tša tšona di ka be di ile tša šwahla tša tswala le mehuta ye mengwe ya digwagwa.
Amharic: በተለያዩ ቦታዎች ለምርምር ጥቅም ላይ ውለው ነበር አንዳንዶቹ ደግሞ አምልጠው ከሌሎች የእንቁራሪት ዝርያዎች ጋር ተዋልደዋል።

English: The frogs were also transported to other countries to be kept as pets, and in fact many other South African species were exported to become “exotic” pets in other countries.
Luganda: Ebikere era byatwalibwa mu mawanga amalala okukuumibwa ng’ebisolo by’awaka, era mu butuufu ebika by’omu South Afrika ebirala bingi byatwalibwa mu mawanga amalala okufuuka ebisolo by’awaka “ebigwira”.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gbé àwọn ọ̀pọ̀lọ́ náà lọ sí àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn ĺti tọ́jú gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohun ọ̀sìn, kódà ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀yà South Áfíríkà ní wọ́n kó lọ sí àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn láti di ohun ọ̀sìn “àjòjì”.
Zulu: Amaxoxo aphinde athuthelwa kwamanye amazwe ukuze agcinwe njengezilwane ezifuywayo, futhi empeleni ezinye izinhlobo eziningi zezilwane zaseNingizimu Afrika zathunyelwa ukuze zibe izilwane ezifuywayo "ezingavamile" kwamanye amazwe.
Hausa: An kuma kai kwaɗin zuwa wasu ƙasashe don a ajiye su a matsayin dabbobin gida, kuma a haƙiƙa an fitar da wasu jinsuna na Afirka ta Kudu da yawa don zama dabbobin gida masu "baƙi" a wasu ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Digwagwa le tšona di ile tša sepetšwa ka dinamelwa go ya dinageng tše dingwe go ya go ba diruiwa tša ka ntlong,gomme go gabotse mehuta ye mengwe ye mentši ya diphedi tša ka Afrika Borwa di ile tša romelwa diruiwa tša ka ntlong tša “dinaga tša ka ntle” ka dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: እንቁራሪቶቹ እንደ ቤት እንስሳ ለመቀመጥ ወደሌሎች ሃገራት ተጓጉዘው ነበር ፤ እንዲያውም ሌሎች ብዙ የደቡብ አፍሪካ ዝርያዎች በሌሎች ሃገራት “ብርቅ” የቤት እንስሳት እንዲሆኑ ወደ ውጪ ተልከዋል።

English: These include wild animals like frogs, toads and geckos, which are not usually kept as pets.
Luganda: Bino mulimu ebisolo by’omu nsiko ng’ebikere, obuwulula n’amakonkome, ebitatera kukuumwa ng’ebisolo by’awaka.
Yoruba: Èyí kò yọ àwọn ẹranko inú agijù sílẹ̀ bí i ọ̀pọ̀lọ́, kọ̀nkọ̀n, àti ọmọ́ọ́lé tí wọ́n ń tọ́jú bí i òhun ọ̀sìn.
Zulu: Lezi zihlanganisa izilwane zasendle njengamaxoxo, amaselesele kanye nezigcilikisha, okungavamisile ukugcinwa njengezilwane ezifuywayo.
Hausa: Waɗannan sun haɗa da dabbobin daji kamar kwaɗi da kuma tsaka, waɗanda ba kasafai ake ajiye su a matsayin dabbobi gida ba.
Northern Sotho: Tšona di akaretša diphoofolo tša lešoka tva go swana le digwaga, dikolopitsane le di tšekho, tšeo ka tlwaelo di sa ruiwe bjalo ka diruiwa tša ka ntlong.
Amharic: እነዚህ አብዛኛውን ጊዜ እንደቤት እንስሳት የማይቀመጡት እንደ እንቁራሪት፣ ቶዶች እና ጌኮዎች የመሰሉ እንስሳቶችን ያካትታሉ።

English: The researchers also said several mammals, reptiles, birds and fish were taken to other countries for sports hunting.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti ebisolo, ebyewalula, ebinyonyi n’ebyennyanja bingi byatwalibwa mu mawanga amalala olw’omuzannyo gw’okuyigga.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tún sọ pé ọ̀pọ̀ ẹranko ti ó ń fi ọmú bọ́ ọmọ, ẹranko afàyàfà, ẹyẹ, àti ẹja ní wọ́n ń kó lọ sí orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn fún ẹrẹ́ ìdíje.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathi izilwane ezincelisayo eziningana, izilwane ezihuquzelayo, izinyoni nezinhlanzi zayiswa kwamanye amazwe ukuze zizingelwe ezemidlalo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma ce an kai dabbobi masu shayarwa da dabbobi masu rarrafe da tsuntsaye da kifaye zuwa wasu ƙasashe domin farautar wasanni.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gape gore diamuši tve mmalwa, digagabi, dinonyana le dihlapi di ile tša išwa dinageng tše dingwe go ya go tsongwa bjalo ka papadi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪ እንዳሉት ብዙ አጥቢ እንስሳት፣ ተሳቢ እንስሳት፣ ወፎች እና አሳዎች ወደሌሎ ሃገራት ለስፖርት አደን ተወስደው ነበር።

English: Some of these were advantageous to these countries for tourism, while others have invaded their surroundings.
Luganda: Ebimu ku bino byali bya mugaso mu mawanga ago olw’ebyobulambuzi, so ng’ebirala byalumbagana obutonde bwabwe.
Yoruba: Díẹ̀ nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni wọ́n ní àǹfàní tí wọ́n ṣẹ fún àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè yìí fún rìn-àjò-afẹ́, nígbà tí àwọn mìíràn ti yabo àyíká wọn.
Zulu: Ezinye zazo bezisiza kula mazwe kwezokuvakasha, kanti ezinye ziye zahlasela izindawo eziwazungezile.
Hausa: Wasu daga cikin waɗannan sun kasance masu fa’ida ga waɗannan ƙasashe domin yawon shaƙatawa, a yayin da wasu suka mamaye kewayensu.
Northern Sotho: Tše dingwe tša tšona di ile tša ba menyetla go dinaga tše go tša boeti, mola tše dingwe di šwahletše ditikologong tša tšona.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ አንዳንዶቹ ለእነዚህ ሃገራት ለቱሪዝም ጠቃሚ ነበሩ አንዳንዶቹ ደግሞ አካባቢያቸውን ወረው ነበር።

English: Despite their best efforts, the researchers cautioned that they could not be 100% certain that all the animals they reported on were originally from South Africa.
Luganda: Newankubadde nga bassaamu kaweefube wa maanyi, abanoonyereza bano baalabula nti baali tebasobola kuba bakakafu ebitundu 100% nti ebisolo byonna bye baayogerako byali bisibuka mu South Africa.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú gbogbo ìgbìyànjú wọ́n tó dára jù, àwọn aṣèwádìí kìlò pé àwọn kò lè sọ pé 100% àwọn ẹranko tí wọ́n jábọ̀ wọn wá láti South Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Naphezu kwemizamo yabo emihle, abacwaningi baxwayise ngokuthi ngeke baqiniseke ngo-100% ukuthi zonke izilwane ababika ngazo zivela eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Duk kuwa da ƙoƙarin da suka yi, masu binciken sun yi gargaɗin cewa ba za su iya tabbatar da kashi 100% ba cewa dukkanin dabbobin da suka yi rahoton sun fito ne daga Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Ka ntle le maitekelo a bona a makaone, banyakišiši ba ile ba eletva gore ba ka se be le bonnete bja 100% bja gore diphoofolo ka moka tše ba begilego ka ga tšona di be di etšwa ka Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: የአቅማቸውን ሁሉ ቢጥሩም ተመራማሪዎቹ ሁሉም ሪፖርት ያቀረቡባቸው እንስሳት ከደቡብ አፍሪካ መሆናቸውን 100% እርግጠኛ እንዳልሆኑ አስጠንቅቀዋል።

English: They said however that this research supports the need to control the spread of invasive species that can cause harm in places that they are not native to.
Luganda: Wabula baagamba nti okunoonyereza kuno kuyamba ku bwetaavu bw’okukugira entambula y’ebisolo n’ebimera eby’obulabe ebisobola okuleeta obulabe mu bifo gye bitali binnansangwa.
